abilities.name: Prepare ventilated food storage
abilities.function: Build a small open raised rack of 2 wood supports and 3 crosspieces that holds separated whole food off the soil; load and unload it, inspect it, compare stored roots with a carried control, maintain or dismantle it.
abilities.costs: Study: 3 rounds. prepare: x, y in reach, orientation; materials: exactly 5 own whole untreated wood units (first 2 supports); optional food and quantity, the proposed load. Round 1 inspects pieces and site, 1 energy; a shortfall is reported and nothing reserved. Then 3 assembly rounds, 1 energy each; prepare naming the rack resumes. load: rack, food (own stack), quantity (at most 4), controlQuantity kept carried as tracked control; 1 round, 0.5 per unit loaded. unload: 0.5 per unit. inspect (anyone) or compare (at least 5 paired rounds): 1 round, 0.5. maintain: replace (piece ids) and as many materials; 1 round, 1. dismantle (empty): 1. cancel: 0. Refusals cost nothing; an unworked round pauses free.
abilities.effects: A unit is a 0.04 x 0.99 m rod (branch). Supports lie 0.8 m apart on firm ground; crosspieces 0.08 m apart make a 0.8 x 0.2 m deck 0.08 m up, one layer of 4 units, rated twice the weakest crosspiece (37 kg each: wood strength/2, bend 0.02 half-span). Pieces become one rack; none stays loose. Loading splits the stack exactly (decay, harvest, origin kept) and lays the lot on the deck under the food water rules; rain wets it, and rain water dries off at their evaporation limit. The decay increment of whole roots there is x0.8 (declared model coefficient) only while the rack is complete and sound, the lot fits, no other material lies on it, there is no rain or standing water, it is outdoors with wind and 0.25 m clear of solids, and the lot is not wetter or warmer than its control (without one, its loading water); else x1. Compare: decay gained by lot and control, exposure, the share unequal temperature explains, verdict. Wear 0.0005 + 0.002 x (rain + wind) a round; a loose crosspiece stops the rate, a loose support drops the food. No reward, refund or food.

abilities.name: Construct and maintain a small weather shelter
abilities.function: Build a hand-lashed low A-frame thatched shelter for one reclining person from rods, binding, dry stems and bedding; inspect, resume, repair, dismantle or cancel it.
abilities.costs: Study 4 rounds. Every paid round is 1 energy. build: x, y in reach, orientation (open end faces local -y), materials as own items with role rod, binding, thatch or bedding; a measured shortfall is refused at no cost. Round 1 inspects site and items; a failure reserves nothing. Then 9 rounds: legs, ridge and rails, battens twice, covering four times, bedding with final inspection. build naming the shelter resumes. inspect (anyone, site or shelter): 1 round. repair: replacements for defects, a round per metre of binding or 0.05 m3 of covering or bedding. dismantle (empty): 2 rounds. cancel: free. Gathering and travel are extra.
abilities.effects: Recipe: 20 rigid wood rods (diameter 0.04 m at 0.01 m precision; legs 0.82 m, others 0.9 m long), at least 30 m of strand (vine 3 m, reed 1.8 m a unit), 0.26 m3 of dry thin-stem covering and 0.1 m3 of dry bedding, volumes from mass, water share (dry at most 0.4) and the stem law; dry grass has none. Inputs become one shelter, 1.6 x 0.8 m under a 0.6 m ridge. Complete only after the final inspection. Occupant: one body wholly on the floor that came in by the open end; a second body voids protection. Rated to rain 5 mm/h (index 1 brings 0.033 mm/h) and wind 5 m/s (index 1 read as 5 m/s): rain on the body x(1 - 0.8 x cover), wind chill x(1 - 0.5 x cover x shelter not facing the wind with its open end), dry bedding halves the ground share (0.25) of cooling; air temperature unchanged. Covering holds rain up to its dry mass, leaks through gaps, dries. Strands and covering wear 0.001 a round, 0.002 in rain or wind; below 0.75 gaps open, below 0.5 lashings fail and the frame collapses. Cancel returns unbuilt inputs once; death stops the work and drops them where the person died; built parts stay until dismantled, returned with condition and water. No reward or refund.

abilities.costs: Study 2 rounds, 0.2 energy each. inspect or measure: 1 round, 0.2 energy; target in reach; specimen is a unit number (default 1). measure: one property; length or diameter needs tools naming a serviceable item with a verified length calibration record, mass a calibrated balance with a verified tare, volume method cylinder and your current length and diameter readings of that unit; tool readings need light; every value needs a separated whole plain unit. Every check precedes payment: a refused request costs nothing. Travel and other specimens or properties are separate actions.
abilities.effects: A personal record and event: target, unit, method, tool and calibration provenance, value, units, resolution, uncertainty, conditions, scope and limits. inspect: form, hand feel, visible dryness, damage, wear, treatment, wholeness; metric values unavailable without a calibrated reference (none exists here; body size, coordinates and stock are never used). measure: value rounded to the resolution; uncertainty = placements x (calibration uncertainty + half the resolution), plus 1% of the length for a strand laid out by hand; below resolution or over range is a paid limit with no value. Units in place, partial or worked items get no reading. Moisture and rigidity are unavailable. construct-weather-shelter@1 rod checks are judged over the uncertainty (meets, fails, indeterminate); suitability stays undetermined unless a check fails. reviews.specification:
Develop 'Investigate and transfer length references', parameterized by mode (investigate, transfer, verify, resume, cancel), accessible target/reference/carrier item IDs, property, quantity, proposed graduation interval and explicit tools. It is available for any applicable actor to study, not bound to Kai or one specimen. Minimal executable precursor: physically investigate one nominated accessible candidate per action, record observed suitability and provenance or the specific missing prerequisite, and stop honestly when no physical standard exists. Do not invent a search result or fabricate a standard from internal numerical dimensions. Investigation may find an uncalibrated comparison length, but that is explicitly nonmetric and cannot satisfy examine-material's calibration requirement.
Reuse and record dependencies on probe for physical observation, examine-material for applicable inspection/readout checks, consult for reading existing records, and existing travel, pickup and marking operations where actually needed; preserve their contracts and costs, without duplicate charges for the same reused action. Exact existing references are probe (open-baseline:probe:1), examine-material (measurement:material-specimen:nondestructive-examination:1), consult (open-baseline:consult:1), and navigate (base:navigate:1). The handoff must bind shared implementations and record code reuse. Do not treat prepare-ventilated-food-storage's nominal rod dimensions, construct-weather-shelter's recipe, source stock, coordinates, body dimensions or render scale as calibration evidence. Kai's item-24-kai-284 is berries, not a demonstrated measuring tool; canopy-69:unit-1:traits is an incomplete qualitative record, not a length standard. No additional facts may be inferred from its unseen pages.
Study costs 2 simulation rounds at 0.2 energy per round, independently per learner. Investigation of one in-reach candidate costs 1 round and 0.2 energy and consumes, reserves and moves no material; inaccessible or nonexistent targets are refused before charging. Ordinary travel and obtaining materials are separate existing actions. Reading a contract alone does not establish a physical fact. Investigation returns a personal evidence record distinguishing observed facts, unsupported claims and unknowns. Report only the scoped conclusion 'no qualifying standard established among these examined candidates', never a global hidden-world search result.
Transfer requires a physically available, serviceable reference bearing an independently justified length value, unit, uncertainty, resolution, range, provenance and current revision; a whole stable carrier of suitable size; adequate light and access; and an actual method of laying off or comparing lengths. Merely declaring a stick to be one metre is invalid. An arbitrary comparison span may be recorded as such, but is never silently converted to metres or accepted by metric shelter checks. If the registry/world supplies no physically realizable standard, report that obstacle with zero fabrication progress; retain investigation as the useful precursor. Do not introduce an arbitrary era gate or a multistage activity roadmap.
The smallest conditional transfer is a single reference span copied onto one already suitable carrier, not an automatic finely graduated ruler. It takes 1 comparison round at 0.2 energy and, if durable endpoint marks are feasible, 1 marking round at 0.2 energy plus any explicit existing marking-tool wear/material cost. The marking mechanism must be physically supported: reuse the existing mark implementation only where its substrate/tool requirements and actual effect suffice; otherwise hand off the missing physical marking mechanism rather than assuming cutting, ink or precision tools. Before commitment, expose the actual carrier, tools, source evidence, required expendables and full costs. No cutting or stock-unit conversion is included. No new material or energy is created: the same carrier acquires only physically performed marks, the reference remains unchanged, and any expendable use or tool wear is deducted exactly once. Investigation never reserves resources; transfer may lock only the named carrier while actively worked, with no ownership transfer or implied permission.
Verification is a separate completed physical comparison, 1 round and 0.2 energy, against the named valid source using an executable alignment method. Record source and carrier revisions, comparison readings, endpoint placement resolution, repetitions, conditions and a conservative uncertainty that includes source uncertainty and each alignment/mark-placement error; do not assume repeated readings remove systematic error. If placement error cannot be bounded physically, calibration remains unverified. A verified single-span carrier has only that usable span/range and actual resolution; no imaginary subdivisions or diameter support. Publish a serviceable length-calibration record in the exact schema consumed by examine-material, with a traceable evidence chain and supported use conditions. Further spans or subdivisions require individually paid actual work and error propagation, not free scale generation. Existing examine-material restrictions on specimen access, properties, placement uncertainty and stale readings remain unchanged. Calibration cannot bypass shelter checks or establish other material properties.
Track completed comparison/mark/verification steps, paid rounds, evidence IDs and actual carrier changes. Pending work advances only on explicit paid actions, never during development/review waiting. Interruption pauses without completing a step; completed physical marks remain but are not a verified calibration. Resume revalidates reference provenance, revisions, tools, access and conditions before accepting previous work; invalidated steps must be redone. Cancel is free, releases locks and retains the carrier in its actual marked/unmarked condition. Death stops work and releases locks; carried objects follow existing death/drop rules, with no duplication or transfer to a reviewer. No spent time, energy, wear or consumed marking material is refunded; untouched inputs remain intact. No autonomous search, fabrication or calibration process runs in the background.
Maintenance is inspection/reverification after damage, deformation, wear, relevant environmental change or any revision affecting length or marks. Such changes invalidate the calibration immediately; elapsed time alone never repairs it. Reverification uses the same paid verification mode and original physical prerequisites. Real products are evidence records, physically marked existing carriers where feasible, and verified calibration only after completed validation. Implement prerequisite checks, provenance validation, conservation, progress and invalidation in code rather than repeated model review.
